title: Productivity suite user, role and MFA export
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: One tenant with four email domains, one per entity; mailboxes for the owner, the Storage manager and a shared Laundry mailbox; the owner's account is the only administrator and uses text-message MFA, with no recovery codes generated; the Storage manager's mailbox and the shared Laundry mailbox have no MFA method registered; the shared Laundry mailbox signs in with one password, last changed before 2026-03-27; the AI assistant add-on license is assigned to the owner's account only

title: Productivity suite retention and log settings
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Deleted items are kept 30 days; no backup service or scheduled export is connected to the tenant; sign-in and audit history is kept 30 days

title: Sign-in recovery and security notice settings in each system
source_system: Account settings pages of the productivity suite, accounting service, payroll service, storage system, property management platform, laundry platform and online banking
what_it_shows: The owner holds an administrator account in each; each lists the owner's business email address as the password reset and security notice address; the codes for the suite, the property management platform and the bank arrive by text message on the owner's phone

title: Accounting service company files, users and security settings
source_system: Accounting service admin settings (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Four company files, one per entity, each with its own bank feed; the vendor enforces authenticator-app MFA for every user; users are the owner (administrator) and the bookkeeper's accountant user, which has access to all four company files, including payee and bank-detail settings; the audit trail records every change; no company file export appears in the history

title: Online banking profile, users, and payment and alert settings
source_system: Online banking (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: One online profile with four business accounts, one per entity; the owner is the only user; a one-time code sent by text message is required for wires and new payees; an email alert is sent for every outgoing payment; the bank offers an app-based token, not enrolled

title: Payroll service employer accounts, users and employee records
source_system: Payroll service admin settings (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Two employer accounts (Storage and Laundry); Rentals has none; the vendor enforces authenticator-app MFA for every user; users are the owner (administrator) and the bookkeeper (payroll entry role); 3 current employees (Storage 1, Laundry 2) and 5 former employees, with SSNs and bank accounts on file; pay runs every second Friday and the service makes the tax deposits; employment records give a storage assistant's last day as 2026-01-16 and a Laundry attendant's last day as 2026-03-27; no benefit plan deductions are set up

title: Storage management system users, security, payment and gate settings
source_system: Storage management system admin settings (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: Three active user accounts: the owner (administrator), the Storage manager (manager role) and a storage assistant account; MFA is available and turned off for every user; card payments use the integrated processor's hosted payment fields, and autopay runs on the 1st; about 610 current and former tenant records with name, address, phone, email, driver license number and gate code; the gate integration logs each code entry; no data export appears in the history

title: Property management platform account, security settings and rent roll
source_system: Property management platform (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: The owner is the only user and signs in with text-message MFA; 12 units in six duplexes, each leased to a current household; rent of about $16,700 a month is due on the 1st and paid by ACH through the tenant portal; 47 applications from 2023 to 2026, with their screening reports, are held in the platform; no data export appears in the history

title: Laundry POS and payment platform users and settings
source_system: Laundry POS and payment platform admin settings (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: The owner is the administrator and signs in with a password only; the POS app runs on one tablet; one 4-digit staff PIN is shared by both attendants, and the PIN history shows no change after 2026-03-27; about 140 wash-and-fold customer records (name, phone, address); the card and app readers on the machines are run by the vendor, which holds about 900 payment app accounts

title: Owner laptop and phone settings review
source_system: Laptop and phone settings screens (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Laptop: full-disk encryption on, with the recovery key saved in the owner's email account; built-in antivirus with real-time scanning on; automatic updates on and the update history current; screen lock on; host firewall on; business passwords saved in the browser and no password manager installed; the downloads folder holds business documents. Phone: passcode set and device encryption on; automatic updates on; receives the text-message codes for the suite, the property management platform and the bank

title: Owner walk-through of the Storage office and the laundromat
source_system: Storage office and laundromat (observation)
what_it_shows: Storage office: the desktop signs in to one shared local account with no password, opens the storage system with a saved password, keeps the Storage manager's mailbox signed in, and shows disk encryption off; built-in antivirus and automatic updates are on; its system information shows it is 7 years old; paper move-in forms are kept in the office and destroyed in a cross-cut shredder. Laundromat: the customer Wi-Fi network name is posted for customers, and the router's connected-device list shows the POS tablet, the payment hub and customer devices on one network; the POS tablet has automatic updates on

title: Gate controller installation record and installer email
source_system: Gate equipment installer invoice and email (owner's inbox, SYS-01)
what_it_shows: The installer configured the gate controller at installation, and no later administrator password change is recorded; the installer states the controller is reachable only from the Storage office network; existing gate codes keep working when the storage system is down; no firmware update is recorded since installation

title: Laptop trade-in record
source_system: Retailer account order history
what_it_shows: One laptop was traded in during 2025; no wipe confirmation or wipe record is kept

title: Search of the owner's files for security documents
source_system: Laptop; suite files and email (SYS-01); paper files at the home office
what_it_shows: For none of the four entities was any of these found: a risk assessment, an inventory of accounts, devices or data, a written security policy, an incident plan, a contact list, a vendor list, a retention or disposal rule, a written payment-change procedure, a security training record, or access instructions for the successor manager

title: Management agreements and LLC operating agreements
source_system: Signed agreements folder
what_it_shows: Three management agreements: the sole proprietorship runs bookkeeping, banking and payments, payroll, vendor contracts, IT accounts, and tenant and customer records for each LLC for a monthly management fee; each LLC is a single-member Florida LLC with the owner as sole member and manager, and has its own bank account, books, insurance and contracts; each operating agreement names a successor manager to manage the LLC if the owner is incapacitated and contains no system access instructions

title: Contractor agreements
source_system: Signed agreements folder
what_it_shows: The outside bookkeeper's engagement letter covers monthly reconciliations and payroll entry for all four entities and contains no confidentiality or security terms; the on-call IT technician's confidentiality and security agreement was signed on 2026-07-24; the CPA firm's engagement letter covers the annual returns, with year-end files sent through the firm's client portal

title: Merchant agreements and card payment settings
source_system: Signed agreements folder; storage system and laundry platform payment settings
what_it_shows: Storage takes cards through the storage system's integrated processor, in hosted payment fields; Laundry's machine readers and payment app are run by the laundry payment vendor; the merchant agreements set the card security duties; no card numbers are stored in the owner's systems or files

title: Bank statements for the four accounts, 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
source_system: Online banking statements (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the productivity suite, accounting service, payroll service, storage system, property management platform and laundry platform vendors, the internet providers and the mobile carrier; payments to the bookkeeper, the IT technician (by the hour), the CPA firm and the maintenance contractor; a general liability premium for each LLC; no payment for a password manager, a backup service or cyber insurance

title: Vendor terms and security documentation
source_system: Vendor websites and help centers
what_it_shows: Each service's terms were accepted online as offered, with no negotiated security terms; each vendor's security page states that traffic uses TLS and that stored data is encrypted; the suite's business terms state that prompts and files are not used to train the vendor's models; vendor security notices go to the account's notice address

title: Accounting service SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Accounting service vendor trust portal
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security, Availability and Confidentiality categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31, with an unqualified opinion; one exception (2 of 40 sampled departing vendor employees lost access 3 and 5 days late), remediated; the hosting and bank-feed providers are carved-out subservice organizations; the system description states RTO 12 hours and RPO 1 hour; backups are encrypted and integrity-checked, and MFA, encryption and the annual recovery test were tested without exception; complementary user entity controls are listed

title: Insurance declarations for each LLC
source_system: Insurance agent portal
what_it_shows: Each LLC carries a general liability policy; no cyber coverage appears on any declarations page; none of the four entities holds a cyber policy

title: Profit and loss by company, FY2025
source_system: Accounting service reporting (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Management fee income of about $180,000 (Storage $72,000, Rentals $48,000, Laundry $60,000); LLC revenue of about $310,000 (Storage), $200,000 (Rentals) and $240,000 (Laundry), about $750,000 combined

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files (prepared by the CPA firm)
what_it_shows: Gross receipts of about $180,000, all management fees; no wages paid; the business is a sole proprietorship with no employees

title: Storage occupancy and rent report, June 2026
source_system: Storage management system reporting (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: 180 units, about 150 rented; rent of about $850 a day; autopay runs on the 1st

title: Laundry sales report, June 2026
source_system: Laundry POS and payment platform reporting (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: Revenue of about $660 a day, about 60% by card or app and the rest by coin; the coin acceptors run the machines without the platform

title: Tenant screening order and decision history
source_system: Property management platform (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Screening reports are ordered from the platform's consumer reporting agency partner only after an applicant applies and consents in the platform, and are delivered inside the platform; the owner accepted the agency's user certification; each report shows an accept, decline or conditional recommendation, and the platform documentation does not describe its basis; unit 4B had six applications: one applicant was approved and two were declined on 2026-07-16, each decline marked report-based with the platform's adverse action notice sent that day

title: AI assistant add-on settings and activity history
source_system: Productivity suite admin console and assistant activity history (SYS-10)
what_it_shows: Turned on 2026-06-01 for the owner's account only; it can open the mail and files the owner's account can open, across all four entities; agent features that send mail or change files are off; the activity history shows drafts of Storage delinquency reminders, laundromat signs and rental listings, summaries of leases and vendor contracts, and, on 2026-07-14, a prompt that summarized six rental applications for unit 4B, including their screening reports, and asked which applicant to choose

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: Owner's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT technician
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the owner says it can tolerate; the owner is the only person who can sign in as administrator, release a payment, issue a gate code remotely or approve an applicant

title: Risk walk-through of the systems and both sites
source_system: Walk-through of each system's settings, the Storage office and the laundromat with the IT technician
what_it_shows: Both sites are locked after hours; the Storage desktop sits in the office and opens without a sign-in; site equipment at the Storage office sits on the floor; the laundromat router has no surge protection; where Restricted data sits day to day (the suite's shared folders, the Storage desktop, the storage system and the property management platform); how a payment request moves from the bookkeeper to the owner and the bank

title: SaaS and bank account review
source_system: User lists, role settings, security settings and sign-in log screens in each SaaS service and online banking, checked with the IT technician
what_it_shows: Manager role in the storage system, payroll-entry role in the payroll service, owner-only access to banking and the property management platform; each vendor records sign-ins and administrative changes; each service has its own sign-in, with no federated sign-on; the payroll provider the LLCs used until 2024 still has an open account that holds former employees' records; no sign-in log has been reviewed

title: Productivity suite file listing
source_system: Productivity suite file storage (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: 47 rental application files from 2023 to 2026 (SSNs, driver license copies, pay stubs, bank statements and screening reports), downloaded as PDFs from the property management platform; about 230 scanned driver license copies of Storage tenants from 2021 to 2024; scanned new-hire forms; all in general shared folders that the owner's account, and so the AI assistant, can open; no deletion record

title: Router and gate controller settings
source_system: Router admin pages at the home office, Storage office and laundromat; gate controller status page
what_it_shows: The home office and Storage office routers block inbound connections; the laundromat router runs one network for the customer Wi-Fi, the POS tablet and the payment hub, and its guest network feature is off; the three routers and the gate controller run the firmware they were installed with

title: Antivirus status pages
source_system: Security settings on the laptop and the Storage desktop
what_it_shows: Built-in antivirus on the laptop and the Storage desktop, with real-time scanning on and signature updates installed automatically

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Owner's written answers to the CSF 2.0 portfolio profile questions, checked on screen with the IT technician
what_it_shows: The owner reused one password on the storage system and the laundry platform; bank-detail change requests that arrive by email are acted on with no callback; staff and contractors raise concerns only by calling the owner, and no rule requires them to; an unfamiliar sign-in alert for the owner's email in May 2026 was deleted unread; vendors were chosen on price and convenience and their terms accepted as offered; the AI assistant was turned on without reading its terms; nothing has been restored or exercised; no entity develops software; staff identity is checked at hire through the I-9 process; the bookkeeper's changes in the accounting files are not reviewed; the laptop and phone are replaced every few years

title: Tenant selection criteria and unit 4B re-check
source_system: Owner's written tenant selection criteria; unit 4B file in the property management platform (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Criteria written on 2026-07-30: income, rental history and screening result; the chosen unit 4B applicant met all three, and the two declined applicants each did not meet the screening criterion; the assistant's 2026-07-14 answer was saved to the unit 4B file in the platform

title: Control assessment: Account management review and test
source_system: User lists in each SaaS service; POS settings; storage system user list test; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No account types, account procedures or account reviews defined for any system; the storage system still listed the former storage assistant (last day 2026-01-16) as enabled, and the owner disabled the account during the test; one Laundry POS PIN and the shared Laundry mailbox password unchanged since an attendant left on 2026-03-27; the bookkeeper's accountant role allows payee and bank changes in all four company files; the former payroll provider account is still open; the owner is the only account manager and creates every account for a known person

title: Control assessment: Administrator MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Administrator sign-ins from a new browser for each SaaS service
what_it_shows: Accounting and payroll administrator sign-ins required an authenticator code; email and property management used text-message codes; the storage system and laundry platform administrator sign-ins needed a password only

title: Control assessment: Staff account MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Sign-ins to the Storage manager's mailbox and storage account and to the shared Laundry mailbox
what_it_shows: The Storage manager's mailbox and storage account and the shared Laundry mailbox signed in with a password only

title: Control assessment: Authenticator review and tests
source_system: Browser password store; password reuse check; gate controller sign-in test; POS PIN settings; owner self-review
what_it_shows: One password reused on the storage system and the laundry platform; passwords saved in the browser; the gate controller accepted the installer's default administrator password; the shared 4-digit POS PIN and the Laundry mailbox password unchanged since 2026-03-27; no written procedure for lost or compromised passwords, PINs or the MFA phone; vendors force a new password at first sign-in and lock accounts after repeated failed sign-ins

title: Control assessment: Encryption status check
source_system: Encryption status on the laptop, phone, Storage desktop and POS tablet; accounting service SOC 2 report
what_it_shows: Laptop and phone encrypted; vendors encrypt stored data; the Storage desktop has no disk encryption and no sign-in

title: Control assessment: Backup review
source_system: Suite retention settings; accounting service SOC 2 report; export history of the LLC systems; owner self-review
what_it_shows: Suite mail and files have no backup beyond 30-day deleted-item retention; no exports from the LLC systems; security documents and contracts exist only in the suite; every copy of suite data sits in the same tenant; the accounting service backs up its platform, with backups encrypted and integrity-checked (SOC 2 report)

title: Control assessment: Vendor and contractor review
source_system: Agreements folder; bookkeeper engagement letter; accounting service user roles; P09 vendor review; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No security or privacy requirements set for any provider, and none in writing for the bookkeeper; the bookkeeper's accountant user also held the company administrator role in all four company files, able to add users; no vendor list or oversight steps; only the accounting service is monitored (SOC 2 review on 2026-07-29); vendor and contractor roles are defined in each service's role settings and in the IT technician's agreement (2026-07-24)

title: Control assessment: Log review self-review
source_system: Suite sign-in log and mailbox rules screen; storage system activity; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No sign-in log, mailbox rule or user activity review has ever been performed; no process to act on review results; no rule to increase review after an incident or alert; an unfamiliar sign-in alert in May 2026 was deleted unread

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting self-review and staff questions
source_system: Contact lists; vendor notice settings; staff instructions; questions to the Storage manager and the Laundry attendants; owner self-review
what_it_shows: Staff and the bookkeeper have no duty or time limit to report suspected incidents to the owner; no list of whom to notify (each LLC, counsel, the bank, vendors, the Department of Legal Affairs); asked whom they would call about a suspicious email and whether they share a PIN, the Storage manager and the Laundry attendants said they had never been told what to do about a suspicious email, a shared PIN or a payment request
